description.value: A preliminary dual-phase 18F-florbetapir PET study comparing perfusion-like and amyloid deposition information among patients with primary progressive aphasia, Alzheimer's disease, and healthy controls.

spans.text: To determine whether dual-phase 18 F-florbetapir positron emission tomography imaging with perfusion-like and amyloid deposition information can distinguish among primary progressive aphasia (PPA), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and healthy controls (HCs).

description.value: An observational, cross-sectional comparison of patients with PPA, AD, and healthy controls enrolled from August 2011 to July 2013.

spans.text: From August 2011 to July 2013, 22 patients including six consecutive patients with PPA (4 with SD and 2 with PNFA), eight age- and sex-matched patients with AD, and eight HCs were enrolled in this study.
All patients were recruited from Chang Gung Memorial Hospital (CGMH), Taiwan.

All participants were fully informed of the nature of the research and signed an informed consent form.
